Raise TypeError for invalid container, pair shape/type, or endpoint type. Raise ValueError for start > end. Empty input returns []. Raise TypeError for any invalid container/name/prerequisite type, ValueError for empty names, unknown prerequisites, self-dependency or any cycle. Return every node once, prerequisites first. At EACH step choose the lexicographically smallest currently ready node, including newly ready nodes. Return [] for empty graph. Never mutate input. Use no imports.
